# 7400 - Quadruple 2-input NAND gate

Package DIP-14 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/7400.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/7400.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 4 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![7400 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/7400.png) | ![7400 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/nand2.png) | ![7400 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/nand2.png) |

A plain tall rectangle, empty inside. Inputs enter on the left, one output line leaves the middle of the right side.

How to tell it on a drawing: Empty box = NAND. No X, no diagonal, no triangle, no second box.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 1Y = NOT(1A AND 1B) | 1Y is the NAND of 1A, 1B. |
| 6 | 2Y = NOT(2A AND 2B) | 2Y is the NAND of 2A, 2B. |
| 8 | 3Y = NOT(3B AND 3A) | 3Y is the NAND of 3B, 3A. |
| 11 | 4Y = NOT(4B AND 4A) | 4Y is the NAND of 4B, 4A. |

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 16 |
| inputSchmitt | no |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 400 ohm, CL 15 pF.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| any | Y | PLH | 11 | 22 |
| any | Y | PHL | 7 | 15 |

## Not known

- outputHighMaxCurrentMa: the recommended-operating-conditions row for IOH -0.4 mA names 'SN5400, SN54LS00, and SN74LS00' and does not name SN7400 (the VOH test condition does use IOH -0.4 mA).

## Notes

The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delay; minNs is null (the path-delay function uses 0 ns). No setup/hold/pulse-width limits apply to a gate, so timingLimits is empty. The pin table gives 3A=10, 3B=9, 4A=13, 4B=12 (A and B are interchangeable in a NAND).

## Sources

- [TI SN5400/SN7400/SN74LS00/SN74S00 datasheet SDLS025D](https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/sn7400.pdf) - 3-4, 7; SN7400
